rationale: The corrected extraction is complete and passed its 60k coverage, image-byte, and two-pass exactness audit.

The confidence floor is not changed after observing DEV, and the abstaining row is neither removed nor assigned a ground-truth-dependent probability.
The same abstention error applies to S0, S1, and shuffled-dimension controls.
